text_block_list.name: Pearl and Windy
text_block_list.text: We are Worldwide Windy—the whirlwind that bites the world!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: These two go by the name "Worldwide Windy." They go around day and night, offering guidance to the troubled… Supposedly, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Most of their activity is shrouded in mystery. They called me into their classroom because they wanted to talk about something, but what could it be?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Welcome to our special emergency meeting. We've been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Today, we got something real important to do. That's right… we needa come up with a new signature pose!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Of course it is! A good pose is crucial if we want those who are lost and in need of assistance to lend us their ears!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The key to connecting with the hearts of those lost little lambs is all about having a striking signature pose when we show up on the scene!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And that's why we want to hear your unbiased opinion on what we come up with. Thanks in advance! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: My vote's for a cool pose! That'll be sure to get everyone lookin' our way!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I propose a pose that would shake people's souls. People are more receptive to suggestions when they're feeling moved!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Windy
text_block_list.text: Which one do you think is best?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their ideas are good, but they both feel like they fall a little short. Neither of them perfectly captures their true charm, so I let them know my honest opinion.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hrk! So we're back to square one?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It might be good to broaden our horizons a bit. Let's head out and see if we can find some inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: We really gonna find inspiration out here? All I see is birds flyin' around.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Birds… Oh, how about we pose with our arms spread out like wings to symbolize us soaring around the world?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: …Uh, that's kinda lame.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You're a tough customer! But that's precisely what I like about you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm thinkin' we go more intense! Something like this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And then a little bit of th—argh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy gets her legs tangled and falls over! But just as she's about to hit the ground—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh no you dooon't!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whoooa!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What just happened?! It felt like I just started levitating!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. I simply twisted my body and scooped you into my arms while doing so.
choice_data_list: You looked just like a whirlwind!
You looked just like a whirlwind!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Windy
text_block_list.text: A whirlwind!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's it! Let's use that spin just now as our pose! After all, we're the whirlwind that bites the world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's mega on-brand and it's got impact!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: 'Cept it sucks 'cause there's no actual bitin' involved…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's an easy problem to solve! We can do a big chomp at the end after we're done spinning like the wind! C'mon, let's try it out!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Windy
text_block_list.text: We are Worldwide Windy!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Windy
text_block_list.text: The whirlwind that bites the world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's it! We did it! I can't wait to show it to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yeah, this is the pose we've been looking for!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A new wind blows across the land, saving all the little lambs. We're biting back against the world's conventions!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's keep practicing our pose so we can make it look super awesome!
choice_data_list: You should make the wind movement faster.
Make sure to add a lot of oomph to that bite!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: How's this?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Time to spin!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whoa… The world… the world's spinnin'…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …No, that's not it! We're the ones spinning the world around! In other words…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's us at the center of the world! Someday, we'll bring forth a mighty whirlwind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As they practice, their spinning gradually gets faster and faster. At this rate, they might actually generate a whirlwind!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If our pose lacks power, it'll make our words sound weak and unconvincing too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Let's get to training! Let's work on holding our pose for as long as we can!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ngh… hold on just a little more! Aaand… whew! Huff, huff… We did it!
choice_data_list: Why would you push yourselves so hard?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Weren't you listening to me earlier? Our pose is the key to opening people's hearts. If we truly want to reach people, we have to be serious!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All you lost little lambs—just you wait! We will show you the way! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As long as Worldwide Windy is here, the lost lambs of the world can rest easy… probably, at least!
